annotations.text: ADR 0104 D13 — three directions for the canonical Mudavym document. Founder, 2026-09-02: "I wanna see the invoice in our formatted template version… the original fetched from the disc on demand… a huge thing to monetize and automate… two or three directions… tell me which is best: scalability, flexibility, robustness." Decided and held constant across all three: one schema in three layers, per-field provenance with as_printed, verdict first, words and numbers never colour alone, confidence never a number, corrections append-only, the delivery as the unit of record, paper stays light in dark mode, hybrid PDF/A-3 export.

How to read them: A tests whether a paper metaphor can carry claims, proposals and provenance without becoming a dashboard. B tests whether making the claim primary loses the accountant. C tests whether the delivery-as-spine makes the agreed invoice obvious or adds chrome a manager approving a bill does not want. Recommendation recorded in ADR 0104's review trail.
